\section{\texttt{theorem-library/} and \texttt{calculus/}}
\label{sec:src-libraries}
\texttt{theorem-library/} holds 235 proof scripts, each reaching \texttt{(qed \ldots)} and gated into the library load; by convention \texttt{X-proof.scm} proves \texttt{X}.  \texttt{calculus/} holds 21 probes and stress tests that are \emph{not} in \texttt{load.scm}.  Rather than enumerate them here, the theorems they prove are indexed, with statements and per-file links, in the generated browser references \texttt{reference/THEOREMS.md} (flat) and \texttt{reference/BY-TOPIC.md} (grouped like a textbook table of contents).

\section{Emacs interface (\texttt{emacs/}) and generated docs}
\label{sec:src-emacs}
The workspace front end lives in \texttt{emacs/}:
\begin{itemize}
\item \texttt{vnb-cmd-gen.el}
\item \texttt{vnb-commands.lisp}
\item \texttt{vnb-complete.el}
\item \texttt{vnb-launch.el}
\item \texttt{vnb.el}
\end{itemize}
The \texttt{reference/} directory is entirely \emph{generated} on prover load (\texttt{STRUCTURE-INDEX}, \texttt{TACTICS}, \texttt{OPERATORS}, \texttt{THEOREMS}, \texttt{BY-TOPIC}, \texttt{PROOF-DEBT}, \ldots) as \texttt{.md}, converted to the browser HTML by \texttt{reference/build-reference-html.py}; it is never hand-edited.
